name: dnd-game-master
description: Anna-native multi-agent D&D game master with setup, safety guardrails, intent routing, combat/rules, NPC dialogue, adventure research, evaluation, approval, persistent campaign state, and optional Gemini Live voice.
author: Yash

credentials.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run key. Not used for Anna text-model calls. The voice_token method accepts it as a fallback when GEMINI_API_KEY is not provided.

credentials.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
credentials.display_name: Gemini API key for Live voice
credentials.description: Optional Anna-specific voice credential. Used only by voice_token to issue a short-lived Gemini Live token; takes precedence over GOOGLE_API_KEY and is never returned or logged.

credentials.name: GOOGLE_MODEL
credentials.description: Present in the original Cloud Run environment file for the ADK backend. Unused by the Anna runtime, which uses Anna llm.sample.

credentials.name: SMART_MODEL
credentials.description: Present in the original Cloud Run environment file for the ADK backend. Unused by the Anna runtime, which uses Anna llm.sample.

credentials.name: USE_LOCAL_LLM
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK setting. Unused by the Anna runtime; model calls are handled through Anna llm.sample.

credentials.name: SESSION_DB_LOCAL
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK session-store setting. Unused by the Anna runtime.

credentials.name: MONGO_URI
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK database setting. Unused by the Anna runtime, which stores campaigns through Anna user-scoped storage.

credentials.name: DB_NAME
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK database setting. Unused by the Anna runtime.

credentials.name: CAMPAIGN_COLLECTION
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK database setting. Unused by the Anna runtime.

credentials.name: SESSION_COLLECTION
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK database setting. Unused by the Anna runtime.

credentials.name: EVENT_COLLECTION
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK database setting. Unused by the Anna runtime.

credentials.name: LOG_LEVEL
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run ADK/FastAPI logging setting. Unused by the Anna runtime.

credentials.name: ALLOW_ORIGINS
credentials.description: Original Cloud Run FastAPI CORS setting. Unused by the static Anna app and bundled Executa.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Set up a D&D party from Open5e class data, consult the Tomb of Annihilation story librarian, and create a grounded opening scene.

parameters.name: party
parameters.description: Party members with name, class, and ancestry.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Optional campaign identifier chosen by the app for durable user-scoped storage.

tools.name: draft_turn
tools.description: Run the guardrail, intent classifier, source-backed story librarian, ACTION/NPC_DIALOGUE/CAMPAIGN specialist, schema and semantic evaluator, and return a player-reviewable draft.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The player's declared action or dialogue.

parameters.name: dice
parameters.description: Optional d20 and d100 rolls selected by the player.

tools.name: resolve_turn
tools.description: Commit a player-approved draft, including campaign scene, party, combat, dialogue, quest, and event history changes, or discard it.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: True to commit the draft; false to discard it.

tools.name: get_class_profiles
tools.description: Return the original Open5e D&D class profiles and archetypes used by the production party builder.

tools.name: voice_token
tools.description: Issue a one-use, short-lived Gemini Live API token for browser voice interaction. Requires an app-configured GEMINI_API_KEY credential.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Voice mode: text for microphone transcription or audio for speech playback.

parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: Optional allowed vocal mood for speech playback.

parameters.name: voice_name
parameters.description: Optional Gemini prebuilt voice name for speech playback.
